findings.title: A senior Department of General Services (DGS) official with Statewide procurement responsibility for OPL also served as President of an association and was involved in activities that potentially violated State Ethics Laws and a Governor’s Executive Order.
findings.description: A DGS senior official responsible for oversight of centralized procurement served as President of a nonprofit association that solicited and received monetary sponsorships from current and prospective State vendors for a trade show. The review noted conditions such as the use of state email accounts to solicit sponsorships, contact information listing state addresses on the association's website, and actions giving the appearance of state affiliation. Senior management at the State Ethics Commission advised these conditions could violate State Ethics Laws and Governor’s Executive Order provisions regarding standards of conduct.

findings.recommendation: We recommend that DGS take immediate action to refer the above information to the State Ethics Commission. We also recommend that DGS, in the future, take appropriate action to ensure compliance with the aforementioned Governor’s Executive Order.
